procedural_matters: 1) GER 205281 did not attend the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance to RRS 63.1(b) 2) The International Jury was represented by Dr. Rainer Kornfeld.
facts: Wind was 10-12 knots, waves were 0.5 to 1 meter.
GER 205281 approaching the finishing line of race 4.
GER 205281 made contact on her port side with the pin end finishing mark while finishing.
GER 205281 did not take a penalty.
No other sailors could see the contact.
conclusions: GER 205281 touched the finishing mark and broke RRS
The International Jury were not satisfied, that RRS 2 was broken.
